about: Hand-checked cases for tests/golden/run.py. Expected numbers come from the formulas in
references/economics.md worked out by hand, not from the scout's code.
quotes: [item, city, lowest ask, ask age h, highest bid, bid age h]; null price = none; null age with a price = AODP's 0001-01-01 date.
history: [item, city, [[from days ago, to days ago, units each day, avg price], ...]]; 1 day ago is the latest full day.
Each case starts from `base` and replaces rows with the same item and city.

cases.name: bag: every check passes
cases.why: Brecilien specializes in bags: 18% + 15% bonus, return rate 0.33/1.33. Raw 8x300 + 8x400 = 5,600; returned 1,389.47; station fee 256 x 0.1125 x 1000/100 = 288; cost 4,498.53. Sale price min(ask 9,000, avg 8,500) = 8,500, net x 0.895 = 7,607.50. Test batch ceil(5% x 20/day) = 1 craft costing 5,600 + 288. Limits hold every other price and solve for a 10% margin.

cases.name: bag: no sales data for 4 days while the city has data
cases.why: Lymhurst cloth has data through yesterday, so the bag's 7-day window is Oct 1-7 and holds only Oct 1-3: 60 units on 3 days.
reasons_include: no sales data in Lymhurst since 2026-10-03, 4 days before that city's latest data

cases.name: bag: whole city feed 4 days behind is only a note
cases.why: Every Lymhurst series ends Oct 3 while Martlock runs to Oct 7: the window is Sep 27 - Oct 3, full, and the lag is noted.
reasons_include: history for Lymhurst ends 2026-10-03, 4 days behind other cities

cases.name: bag: whole city feed 5 days behind is a watch
reasons_include: sales history for Lymhurst is stale: ends 2026-10-02, 5 days behind other cities

cases.name: bag: 9.9% margin is a watch
bag: 10.1% margin passes
bag: 5.0 sold a day passes
bag: 4.9 sold a day is a watch
bag: data on 4 of 7 days passes
bag: a cheap input is costed at its 7-day average
cases.why: 150 is below 70% of the 300 average, so the cost uses 300 and matches the first case.
reasons_include: input T4_CLOTH ask 150 is far below its 7-day avg 300 in Lymhurst; costed at the average

cases.name: bag: sale quote older than 12 h is a watch
bag: main input quote older than 12 h is a watch
cases.why: Leather costs 3,200 a craft against cloth's 2,400, so it is the main input.
reasons_include: main input T4_LEATHER quote is 13.0h old (limit 12h)

cases.name: bag: a smaller input 8 h old is only a note
bag: a city with steady sales beats a pricier thin one
cases.why: Martlock nets 8,502.50 but sells 2 a day; Lymhurst nets 7,607.50, sells 20 a day and still clears 10%.

cases.name: bag: an ask far above the average is a watch
cases.why: 12,000 is 41% above the 8,500 average; the sale uses 8,500.
reasons_include: current price 12,000 is >30% from 7-day avg 8,500; used the lower

cases.name: bag: a 0001-01-01 date means no price
bag: no sales history is an avoid
reasons_include: no observed sales in Lymhurst in the last 7 days; demand unverified

cases.name: bag: quotes only, as in scan stage 1
cases.why: Without history the sale is the lowest ask: 9,000 x 0.895 = 8,055.

cases.name: bag: red-zone sale shows the safe route
cases.why: The Black Market buy order nets 10,000 x 0.92 = 9,200 (no setup fee). Without it, Lymhurst as in the first case.
reasons_include: route risk: red zones (full-loot PvP) to reach the Black Market (in Caerleon)

cases.name: bag: budget caps the test batch
cases.why: 5% of 200 a day = 10 crafts, but 20,000 buys only 3 at 5,888 each.

cases.name: potion: makes 5 per craft
cases.why: Raw 24x50 + 6x100 = 1,800; returned at 0.33/1.33; fee 40 x 5 x 0.1125 x 10 = 225. Revenue 5 x 400 x 0.895 = 1,790. Test batch ceil(5% x 500 / 5) = 5 crafts of 2,025.

cases.name: sword: the artifact gets no resource return
cases.why: Only the 3,200 of bars returns: 3,200 x 0.33/1.33. Item value 16 x 16 (artifact value unknown) gives a 288 fee. The artifact limit gains the whole slack because none of it comes back.

cases.name: faction cape: no specialization, no returns, no item value
cases.why: Craft where most silver is spent (Thetford). Nothing returns, and with no item value the fee is left for the player to check.

expect.city_note: no city specialization; any Royal city gives the same return rate

cases.name: planks: refining gets the 40% city bonus
enchanted bag: @1 IDs throughout
mount: a recipe needing faction points is an avoid
